entities.summary: Omari Kamau Moore is an American–born naturalized Macedonian professional basketball player for Valencia of the Spanish Liga ACB and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball for the San Jose State Spartans of the Mountain West Conference. As a senior in 2023, Moore was the Mountain West Player of the Year.
